title: Medical Student Research Fellow
description: Spend a funded research year with a clinician mentor in translational medicine and clinical outcomes research. Open to enrolled medical students in their clinical years. Work on a protocol, analyze de-identified study data and present findings at a departmental seminar.

title: Internal Medicine Away Rotation
description: A supervised clinical elective for visiting medical students who have completed core clerkships. Observe care transitions and contribute to a clinical quality improvement elective. Home school approval is required.

title: Academic Hospitalist
description: Join academic general medicine as clinical faculty. The position includes resident supervision, protected research time and teaching on an inpatient service. Internal medicine residency completion and a state medical license are required.

title: Clinical Faculty in General Internal Medicine
description: This internal medicine physician role includes protected research time and small-group teaching. Clinical work focuses on complex primary care and practice improvement.

title: Security Operations Intern
description: Work with a mentor in a detection lab, review endpoint alerts and assist with incident triage. Enrolled undergraduate cybersecurity students can apply.

title: Digital Forensics Intern
description: Document evidence handling and conduct a blue team exercise with a defender. The program includes a student security research project.

title: Detection Engineer
description: Own endpoint detection and threat hunting in a security operations center. Validate analytic rules against realistic traffic and maintain incident response playbooks.

title: Incident Response Analyst
description: Coordinate cloud security response with application teams, investigate anomalies and update incident response playbooks after each case.

title: Epidemiology Practicum
description: A health department placement for MPH students. Summarize disease surveillance indicators, learn applied biostatistics and present findings under the supervision of the county epidemiologist.

title: Surveillance Intern
description: Assist with disease surveillance, clean reporting data and support applied public health training with a site preceptor.

title: Field Epidemiologist
description: Lead outbreak investigation, strengthen public health preparedness and design surveillance system evaluation for a regional reporting network.

title: Epidemiologist II
description: Support surveillance system evaluation and occupational epidemiology in coordination with partner health departments.

title: Energy Systems Intern
description: Prototype building energy modeling workflows and assist battery storage research. Work with an engineer to measure community decarbonization outcomes.

title: Grid Modeling Intern
description: Study distribution constraints and work on energy burden analysis. The internship is part of a graduate clean energy fellowship.

title: Distributed Energy Engineer
description: Conduct distribution planning and scope virtual power plant integration. Partner with utility program teams on measurement and verification.

title: Grid Interconnection Engineer
description: Review requests for new distributed generation and model feeder behavior. Collaborate with planners on demand flexibility.

title: Accessibility Design Intern
description: Plan supervised usability testing and accessible prototyping for a civic service. Join a participatory design workshop with users of assistive technology.

title: UX Research Intern
description: Assist with usability testing and observe interviews with assistive technology users. Review accessible prototyping decisions with a mentor.

title: Digital Accessibility Specialist
description: Define accessible design systems and conduct WCAG testing. Work with service teams to review accessibility conformance and prioritize fixes.

title: Accessibility Product Designer
description: Lead assistive technology research and prototype inclusive fare services. Translate research findings into acceptance criteria for accessible design systems.

title: Robotics Engineering Intern
description: Build a robotics prototype, support sensor integration and practice test fixture design with a supervising engineer.

title: Mechatronics Intern
description: Calibrate sensors and document a robotics prototype. The placement includes a supervised controls laboratory internship project.

title: Robotics Controls Engineer
description: Develop motion control for electromechanical assemblies. Own hardware in the loop tests and review functional safety with the operations team.

title: Robotics Integration Engineer
description: Integrate production sensors and lead robotic workcell validation. The team investigates motion control faults before release.

title: Audit Intern
description: Support financial statement testing and internal control testing. Prepare audit workpapers under a licensed supervisor.

title: Public Sector Audit Internship
description: Examine samples of agency expenditure and maintain audit workpapers with a mentor. Current accounting students are eligible for consideration.

title: Senior Auditor
description: Own audit planning and internal controls assessment for nonprofit clients. Review financial reporting controls and mentor associates.

title: Audit Manager
description: Lead government performance audit engagements and review fieldwork. The position supports annual audit planning and quality review.

title: Public Interest Law Intern
description: Work in a housing justice clinic on legal research and writing. A supervising attorney reviews all client-facing materials.

title: Summer Law Intern
description: Support a civil rights internship with legal research and writing and attend supervised intake meetings.

title: Legal Aid Staff Attorney
description: Deliver civil legal services and tenant representation. Develop public benefits advocacy with a team of supervising attorneys.

title: Housing Justice Attorney
description: Provide tenant representation, develop eviction defense materials and mentor volunteer counsel.

title: Elementary Teacher Residency
description: Join a teacher preparation cohort with supervised classroom practice. Co-plan lessons with a mentor teacher and meet regularly with a university supervisor.

title: Student Teaching Placement
description: Join a semester of supervised classroom practice and classroom observation in an elementary school.

title: Instructional Coordinator
description: Lead assessment development and teacher professional development. Evaluate curriculum implementation with grade-level teams.

title: Curriculum Specialist
description: Support curriculum implementation and instructional materials adoption. Design teacher professional development with school leaders.

title: Museum Education Intern
description: Develop object-based learning activities and practice museum interpretation with a supervisor. Help staff adapt family programs for different age groups.

title: Visitor Experience Internship
description: Observe visitor programs and help a mentor test object-based learning scripts. The placement includes a museum outreach internship project.

title: Museum Education Manager
description: Lead community interpretation and visitor studies evaluation. Coach educators and oversee partnerships with public libraries.

title: Interpretive Program Manager
description: Coordinate exhibition interpretation and visitor studies evaluation. Manage a public humanities fellowship with a community partner.

title: Water Resources Intern
description: Support water treatment research, water sampling and supervised review of hydraulic model inputs. Present a short analysis to the utility engineering team.

title: Drinking Water Intern
description: Document water sampling methods and assist staff with treatment process observations. Designed for current engineering students.

title: Water Infrastructure Engineer
description: Lead water treatment design, hydraulic modeling and utility capital planning for pump and treatment upgrades.

title: Drinking Water Engineer
description: Lead water treatment design reviews for municipal clients. Support utility capital planning for treatment upgrades.

title: Machine Learning Research Intern
description: Run reproducible evaluation of scientific machine learning models. The doctoral research internship provides access to compute, a mentor and protected writing time.

title: AI Research Internship
description: Study scientific foundation models and build a reproducible evaluation suite for small scientific datasets.

title: Machine Learning Research Scientist
description: Develop scientific foundation models, lead uncertainty quantification experiments and build model evaluation infrastructure. Collaborate with domain scientists on publications.

title: Applied Research Scientist
description: Advance representation learning for noisy sensor data and publish comparative model evaluation infrastructure results with research partners.

title: Quantitative Research Intern
description: Conduct market microstructure research, prototype forecasting signals and learn systematic strategy research with a research mentor.

title: Quantitative Analyst Internship
description: Build a small pricing project during a financial engineering internship. Present out-of-sample research results to a quantitative team.

title: Systematic Quantitative Researcher
description: Lead alpha research, transaction cost modeling and portfolio construction for systematic strategies. Document out-of-sample robustness and execution assumptions.

title: Market Microstructure Researcher
description: Run execution research and transaction cost modeling. Work with engineering to deploy empirical findings into the simulation framework.

title: Particle Physics Graduate Fellowship
description: A graduate student research placement in collider data analysis and detector calibration. Includes a laboratory mentor, collaboration meetings and computing time for dissertation work.

title: Experimental Particle Physics Internship
description: Work on detector calibration while attending a detector instrumentation school. Students document calibration constants and uncertainties.

title: Experimental Particle Physics Postdoc
description: Lead collider physics analysis and contribute to detector reconstruction and trigger development. The work includes collaboration reviews and mentoring.

title: Particle Physics Research Scientist
description: Develop instrumentation and detector reconstruction methods for a new experiment. Share responsibility for on-detector commissioning.

title: Elementary Teacher Residency Observer
description: Join a teacher preparation cohort and attend classroom observation. You may be offered supervised classroom practice if a classroom opens.

title: Seasonal Cashier
description: Run a point of sale and replenish shop displays.

title: Ballet Company Tour Coordinator
description: Plan touring schedules, freight and rehearsal spaces for a dance company.

title: Pastry Production Apprentice
description: Learn dough preparation and batch timing with a pastry chef.

title: Marine Cargo Scheduler
description: Coordinate cargo manifests and shipping windows with port operators.
